items.name: Cloak of Resistance +1
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description: This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.

items.name: Zar'eth Choker
items.description:
This heavy leather choker was once a slave collar of Cheliax, its inner surface still bearing the scars of binding sigils long since burned away. At its front is set a brass infernal seal, hammered flat and reforged, engraved with the High Infernal glyph Zar’eth—Freedom Through Law. The mark glows faintly like banked embers when the wearer asserts their will.
Unlike most symbols of rebellion, the Brand of Earned Liberty is a lawful instrument, recognized by infernal jurisprudence and Hellknight

items.name: Chelish Scout Chain Shirt
items.description:
The Chelish Scout Chain Shirt is a finely crafted piece of armor, renowned for its exquisite design and bronze sheen that catches the light with every movement. Fashioned in Cheliax, this chain shirt is not just a protective garment but a work of art, designed for those who blend into society with both style and function. It provides excellent protection while allowing for mobility, ideal for scouts exploring the dense forests and treacherous terrains of the region.
Aura: faint transmutation

items.name: Infernal Scroll of Raise Dead
items.description: This ancient scroll is penned on dark parchment with crimson ink, bearing the infernal sigils of Asmodeus, the Prince of Darkness. Its edges are adorned with golden flames, and a faint scent of brimstone clings to it. The scroll holds the power to restore life to the deceased, but whispers of infernal bargains accompany its use. Clerics of Asmodeus are known for their cunning and guile, and those who use this scroll may find themselves owing a favor to the dark god or bound by some unseen pact.

items.name: Ring of the Chelish Agent
items.description: This elegant ring is crafted of dark silver and etched with the emblem of House Thrune, the ruling family of Cheliax. It is a mark of authority and protection among agents of the Chelish government. The ring is often awarded to those who have proven their loyalty and prowess in the service of the infernal nation. The wearer feels a subtle aura of safety and strength, as if shielded by an unseen force.

items.name: Chelish Service Saber
items.description:
The Chelish Service Saber is the standard-issue melee weapon for trusted crew aboard Chelish naval vessels—such as boatswains, veteran navigators, and long-serving able seamen. It strikes a balance between form and function: simple enough to mass-produce for the imperial navy, but elegant enough to signal discipline and readiness.
